prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1472; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at a signalized intersection involving your insured. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this loss and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, telematics or vehicle data, dashcam footage, repair estimates, and any signal timing or traffic camera records in your possession. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal procedures that could affect these materials. We look forward to your prompt written response.
